daily.notification.title.reference.notes: REFERENCE ONLY — not shippable as is: contains the trademark 'BeReal' used as a verb; the ⚠️ hazard framing is urgency (tenet 5, do-not-copy). Help-article titles write it without spaces: '⚠️Time to BeReal.⚠️' (articles 7350386715165, 15416869159197).

daily.notification.body.reference.text: 2 min left to capture a BeReal and see what your friends are up to!
daily.notification.body.reference.notes: REFERENCE ONLY — not shippable as is: trademark 'BeReal'; '2 min left' is deadline framing (do-not-copy, tenet 5). The invitation clause 'see what your friends are up to' carries no urgency.

daily.notification.interruptionLevel.ref.notes: iOS system header rendered for UNNotificationInterruptionLevel.timeSensitive. Do-not-copy: breaks through Focus (urgency, tenet 5).

daily.notification.group.title.reference.notes: REFERENCE ONLY — not shippable as is: group (RealGroup) variant; trademark + ⚠️ urgency.

daily.notification.rule.timing.reference.text: Every day, everyone in your time zone receives a notification at the same time (before you ask, we truly do not know when it’s sent). You have 2 minutes to open the app and take your BeReal.
daily.notification.rule.timing.reference.notes: Behaviour reference, not UI copy. Night hours excluded: 'don’t worry, we won’t crash your beauty sleep in the middle of the night' (article 15416869159197).

daily.notification.voice.reference.lateC.text: Post on time or post late—it still counts.
daily.notification.voice.reference.lateC.notes: Voice example; the only non-punitive BeReal line about lateness. Pattern evidence, not UI copy.

daily.notification.voice.reference.oneDa.text: One daily notification. Two minutes. Real friends, real moments.

notifications.push.friendsPosted.referen.evidence: references/auto/bereal/store/bereal-store-03.png (banner x150-1150 y820-1040: 'Claire ✨ and 24 others posted a BeReal'; title line 'BeReal.'); owner references/owner/bereal-03-same-time-feed.webp
notifications.push.friendsPosted.referen.notes: REFERENCE ONLY — not shippable as is: trademark; '{count} others' is a count (tenet: no counts). Name and '{count} others' are bold; no final period. Marketing composite.

notifications.push.settings.daily.title..notes: REFERENCE ONLY — not shippable as is: trademark. Group setting toggle.

notifications.push.settings.daily.footer.text: Set up a daily reminder for everyone to post a BeReal together
notifications.push.settings.daily.footer.notes: REFERENCE ONLY — not shippable as is: trademark; 'reminder' framing. Footer under the toggle; no final period.

notifications.push.settings.timeTo.title.notes: REFERENCE ONLY — not shippable as is: trademark.

notifications.push.settings.timeTo.foote.text: Get notified when it's time to BeReal in this conversation
notifications.push.settings.timeTo.foote.notes: REFERENCE ONLY — not shippable as is: trademark.

notifications.push.settings.messages.tit.notes: Generic word; verbatim usable. The settings surface itself is assigned to Apple HIG / Material 3.

notifications.push.settings.messages.foo.notes: Generic; verbatim usable. Pattern: 'Get notified for/when …', sentence case, no period.

daily.capture.countdown.format.notes: Both fields zero-padded to 2 digits. Format only; no label text accompanies the countdown.

daily.capture.send.notes: All caps, followed by a right-pointing triangle glyph (separate icon).

daily.capture.audience.chip.reference.notes: 2023 build reads 'My Friends' (references/auto/bereal/help/help-21083708285725_bts-post-preview-2x.png; store-02 with lock glyph). Help 'Audience' article lists '1. My friends only'. Adapt by noun swap (friends → group noun) if an audience chip is used.

daily.capture.location.chip.off.notes: Location chip off state, with a slashed location-arrow glyph.

daily.capture.prompt.during.reference.1.text: Smile now, uh I mean now
daily.capture.prompt.during.reference.1.notes: Shown centred under the arc spinner while captures run. DO-NOT-COPY: smile directive conflicts with 'Real, not performed'. Layout (spinner + one centred line) is reusable.

daily.capture.prompt.noface.reference.1.notes: Shown when no face is visible. Recorded; face detection not part of our build.

daily.capture.prompt.noface.reference.3.text: Your friends will definitely prefer to see your face!

daily.capture.prompt.after.reference.1.text: Keep smiling and don't change a thing
daily.capture.prompt.after.reference.1.notes: Shown over the post preview right after capture (≥2.6 s). DO-NOT-COPY (smile directive).

daily.capture.help.retake.reference.text: You can retake your BeReal as many times as you want before posting. Just keep an eye on the timer.
daily.capture.help.retake.reference.notes: REFERENCE ONLY — not shippable as is: trademark; 'keep an eye on the timer' = deadline framing. Behaviour: unlimited retakes before posting.

daily.capture.late.label.reference.evidence: references/auto/bereal/store/bereal-store-05.png ('5 min late'); AP 10.5 s ('5 min late'); references/auto/bereal/frames/appstore-preview-2026_t8.30s_feed-late-label.png ('Paris, 1st Arr • 9m late'); references/auto/bereal/frames/appstore-preview-2026_t6.80s_feed.png ('27 h late')
daily.capture.late.label.reference.notes: DO-NOT-COPY ('late' labels). Formats differ: '5 min late', '9m late', '27 h late'.

daily.capture.late.bonusLocked.reference.text: Posted late? The option to post Bonus BeReal is locked. No worries! There’s always tomorrow.
daily.capture.late.bonusLocked.reference.notes: DO-NOT-COPY (punishes lateness). Voice example: rhetorical question + 'No worries!'.
